name: Tanco Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，Tanco Holdings Berhad 通过子公司 Tanco Dot Com 与 China Mobile International 签署谅解备忘录，探索在 Port Dickson 建设50MW IT负载数据中心；通过79%持股的 Midports Holdings 与 SPG Qingdao Port Group 签署谅解备忘录，涉及 Port Dickson 的智能AI集装箱港口项目。同时，公司就 Port Dickson 一幅土地（收购价8850万令吉）及为 Port Dickson 自由区第一阶段开发提供最高2.5亿令吉财务援助的事项继续推进。
overview_en: In 2026, Tanco Holdings Berhad, through its subsidiary Tanco Dot Com, signed an MOU with China Mobile International to explore the development of a 50MW IT load data centre in Port Dickson; through its 79%-owned subsidiary Midports Holdings, it signed an MOU with SPG Qingdao Port Group concerning a proposed Smart AI Container Port in Port Dickson.

segments.name: 房地产开发/管理
segments.note: 推进 Port Dickson 一幅土地的收购及 Port Dickson 自由区第一阶段开发的财务援助安排。
segments.note_en: Progressing the acquisition of a parcel of land in Port Dickson and the financial assistance arrangement for the development of the first phase of Port Dickson Free Zone.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 已向 Bursa Securities 提交土地估值报告。
actions.text_en: Submitted the valuation report for the land to Bursa Securities in relation to the proposed acquisition and provision of financial assistance.

actions.text: Port Dickson, Mukim Pasir Panjang 的一幅土地，用于该收购及 Port Dickson 自由区第一阶段开发。

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 探索数据中心和智能AI集装箱港口新项目，并推进预制构件合资。
segments.note_en: Exploring new data centre and Smart AI Container Port projects, and progressing a precast joint venture.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 79%持股子公司 Midports Holdings Sdn. Bhd. 与 SPG Qingdao Port Group Co., Ltd. 签署谅解备忘录，涉及在 Negeri Sembilan, Port Dickson 的智能AI集装箱港口项目，以及 MHSB 可能进行的相关筹资活动。
actions.text_en: 79%-owned subsidiary Midports Holdings Sdn. Bhd. entered into an MOU with SPG Qingdao Port Group Co., Ltd.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 Tanco Dot Com Sdn. Bhd. 与 China Mobile International Limited 签署谅解备忘录，探索在 Negeri Sembilan, Port Dickson 开发及建设50MW IT负载数据中心。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Tanco Dot Com Sdn. Bhd. entered into an MOU with China Mobile International Limited to explore the development and building of a 50MW IT load data centre in Port Dickson, Negeri Sembilan.

actions.title: PROPOSED JOINT VENTURE BETWEEN TANCO PRECAST INDUSTRIES SDN BHD AND KING WELL HOLDINGS LIMITED ("PROPOSED JOINT VENTURE")

actions.text_en: Responded to Bursa Malaysia's query on the proposed joint venture between Tanco Precast Industries Sdn Bhd and King Well Holdings Limited, providing information on the joint venture party.

model_changes.text_en: Exploring entry into the data centre business through an MOU to develop a 50MW IT load data centre in Port Dickson.
